timing_and_honesty.observed_before_freeze: The eight-test directional primary family had been computed and was null after multiplicity control. The fixed h5 sparse strategy was descriptively positive but uncertain.
timing_and_honesty.not_observed_before_freeze: No absolute-return, squared-return, volatility or reaction-magnitude regression, OOS comparison, p-value, bucket result or plot had been computed.
timing_and_honesty.status: Post-primary exploratory family. It cannot rescue the directional alpha hypothesis and cannot unlock 2026 confirmation returns.

question: Does model-scored firm-specific economic materiality identify the magnitude of post-news price reactions beyond the absolute strength of existing Gemma and FinBERT polarity?
motivation: The annotation prompt measures valuation relevance and horizon rather than forecasting returns. Economic materiality may therefore be useful for attention or risk triage even when signed direction is not tradable.
confirmation_boundary: Identical fail-closed pre-2026 loader and exact forward-return boundary from the parent waiver; confirmation_rows_opened must remain zero.

primary_family.regression: OLS with development-standardised continuous predictors and entry-session-clustered covariance. Primary coefficient is materiality; expected direction is positive.
primary_family.multiplicity: BH-FDR q=0.05 across h1, h5 and h20 materiality coefficients.

secondary_validation.chronological_oos: Reuse the three expanding folds. Compare polarity-magnitude-plus-novelty base against the same model plus materiality using squared-error loss. Report one-sided five-session block-bootstrap p-values and BH q-values across h1/h5/h20.
secondary_validation.buckets: Plot raw absolute return by none/low/moderate/high-or-very-high model materiality. Buckets are descriptive; no threshold is promoted.
secondary_validation.stability: Report 2024 and 2025 coefficients, leave-one-company-out coefficient ranges and high-bucket company concentration. These are descriptive robustness diagnostics.
secondary_validation.strategy_boundary: No trade rule is created from reaction magnitude. The potential application is news triage, risk sizing or volatility forecasting, not directional alpha.

decision_rule.usable_development_finding: A positive materiality coefficient survives the three-test BH family at one or more horizons, the same horizon has non-negative OOS loss improvement, and the sign is positive in both calendar years. Otherwise report a clean reaction-magnitude null.
